auth_admin_keep.value.description: If enabled, allows any user to execute commands as any other user without authentication. Should only be enabled in trusted environments.

rules.description: List of custom PolicyKit rules to define authorization behavior.

name.description: Descriptive name for the rule (used internally).

description.description: Human-readable description shown in the rule comment.

match_user.description: Username to match (e.g., 'root' or 'alice'). Leave blank to omit user match.

match_group.description: Group name to match (e.g., 'wheel' or 'admin'). Leave blank to omit group match.

action_result.description: Optional per-action override for result ('yes', 'no', 'auth_admin', 'auth_admin_keep'). If absent, defaults to 'yes'.
